kilauea_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY DAILY UPDATE
kilauea_notices.message: HVO Kilauea ORANGE/WATCH - Kīlauea has been intermittently erupting bursts of spatter building a small cone around the north vent in Halemaʻumaʻu; no precursory flows since September 12. Summit inflation stalled last night further delaying the onset of episode 55 fountaining.

mauna_loa_notices.title: HAWAIIAN VOLCANO OBSERVATORY MONTHLY UPDATE
mauna_loa_notices.message: HVO Haleakala GREEN/NORMAL - No activity of concern for Haleakalā.
